name: BANYAN TREE
creator: Jimmy Gunawan
attribution: BANYAN TREE by Jimmy Gunawan, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
usage: Close-up scan of the lower trunk and aerial roots, used for the banyan item in Life → বাংলাদেশের গাছপালা → বট. It is not a whole-tree scan; the source does not specify scientific species or location.
modifications: Quantized supported vertex attributes using glTF Transform 4.5.1; mesh UVs were preserved.
limitations: Close-up of the trunk base and aerial roots; it does not include the complete canopy or whole tree.
The scan was reconstructed from 12 photos; its source has no scientific-species identification or geographic location.
Static scan with no authored animation.
